# TBCache
> TBCache provides a transparent, standards-compliant HTTP caching proxy for APIs and web services.

TBCache focuses on adding HTTP caching behavior in front of upstream services, with documentation covering setup, configuration, cache semantics, and operational guidance.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://tbcache.com/docs): Main entry point for TBCache documentation and product usage guidance.
- [Getting Started](https://tbcache.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory setup guide for running TBCache and sending cached requests.
- [Configuration](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration): Reference for configuring cache behavior, upstreams, and runtime options.
- [Caching Semantics](https://tbcache.com/docs/caching): Explains HTTP cache rules, freshness, validation, and cache-control handling.
- [Deployment](https://tbcache.com/docs/deployment): Guidance for deploying TBCache in production environments and infrastructure.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tbcache.com/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues, debugging steps, and operational problem-solving advice.

## Core Concepts
- [How It Works](https://tbcache.com/docs/how-it-works): Overview of request flow, cache lookup, revalidation, and response serving behavior.
- [Cache Keys](https://tbcache.com/docs/cache-keys): Describes how requests are normalized and mapped to cache entries.
- [Freshness and Revalidation](https://tbcache.com/docs/freshness-and-revalidation): Details expiration, validators, and conditional requests to upstreams.
- [Cache-Control Support](https://tbcache.com/docs/cache-control): Documents supported HTTP cache directives and their effects.
- [Vary Handling](https://tbcache.com/docs/vary): Explains how Vary headers influence cache partitioning and response selection.
- [Invalidation](https://tbcache.com/docs/invalidation): Covers cache purge and invalidation strategies where supported.

## Configuration Reference
- [Environment Variables](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/environment-variables): Lists environment-based configuration options for running TBCache.
- [Upstream Configuration](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/upstreams): Defines how to connect TBCache to origin services and APIs.
- [Storage Backends](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/storage): Describes cache storage options and backend-specific settings.
- [TTL and Expiration](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/ttl): Explains time-to-live controls and expiration-related configuration.
- [Headers and Policies](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/headers): Documents header overrides, policy controls, and request handling settings.
- [Logging and Metrics](https://tbcache.com/docs/configuration/observability): Configuration for logs, metrics, and runtime observability.

## Guides
- [Run Locally](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/run-locally): Step-by-step guide for starting TBCache in a local development environment.
- [Cache an API](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/cache-an-api): Walkthrough for placing TBCache in front of an API service.
- [Using Docker](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/docker): Instructions for containerized deployment and local testing with Docker.
- [Reverse Proxy Setup](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/reverse-proxy): Shows how to position TBCache as a reverse proxy in front of origins.
- [Production Hardening](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/production): Best practices for reliability, scaling, and secure production operation.
- [Debugging Cache Misses](https://tbcache.com/docs/guides/debugging-cache-misses): Practical techniques for understanding misses and unexpected cache behavior.

## API and Protocol
- [HTTP Interface](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/http): Reference for interacting with TBCache over standard HTTP requests.
- [Administrative Endpoints](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/admin): Documents management and operational endpoints exposed by TBCache.
- [Health Checks](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/health): Describes liveness and readiness endpoints for service monitoring.
- [Metrics Endpoint](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/metrics): Reference for metrics exposure and scraping by observability systems.
- [Purge API](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/purge): Explains programmatic cache invalidation and purge request behavior.
- [Status Codes and Headers](https://tbcache.com/docs/api/headers): Lists response headers and status semantics added by TBCache.

## Operations
- [Monitoring](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/monitoring): Guidance for tracking cache performance, errors, and service health.
- [Logging](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/logging): Operational logging practices and interpretation of runtime output.
- [Scaling](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/scaling): Recommendations for horizontal scaling and capacity planning.
- [Persistence](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/persistence): Notes on durable cache storage and restart behavior.
- [Security](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/security): Security considerations for deployment, access control, and upstream protection.
- [Backups and Recovery](https://tbcache.com/docs/operations/recovery): Recovery planning and operational continuity guidance.

## Examples
- [Example Configurations](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/configurations): Sample configuration files for common deployment and caching scenarios.
- [API Caching Examples](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/api-caching): Concrete examples of caching API responses with standard HTTP semantics.
- [Header Behavior Examples](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/headers): Demonstrates how request and response headers affect cache outcomes.
- [Docker Compose Example](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/docker-compose): Ready-to-run compose setup for local experimentation and testing.
- [Kubernetes Example](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/kubernetes): Example manifests for deploying TBCache on Kubernetes.
- [Purge Workflow Example](https://tbcache.com/docs/examples/purge): Shows practical cache invalidation workflows and request patterns.

- [Home](https://tbcache.com/): Product overview and entry point for TBCache resources.

- [Changelog](https://tbcache.com/changelog): Release notes and version-by-version summary of product changes.
- [Pricing](https://tbcache.com/pricing): Plans and commercial packaging for using TBCache.
- [Contact](https://tbcache.com/contact): Contact options for support, sales, or general product inquiries.
